biometricaskdisable: You can sign in with your fingerprint or face. Do you want to stop and sign in only with your PIN?
biometricaskenable: You sign in with your PIN. Do you also want to use your fingerprint or face? It is optional and you can turn it off at any time.
biometricdisabled: Done: you will sign in with your PIN.
biometricenabled: Done: next time you can use your fingerprint or face.
biometricneedspin: To use your fingerprint or face you first need a PIN. You create it when you sign in with the link or QR code of your organisation.
biometriconeaccount: This phone keeps the fingerprint or face for one account only: {{name}}, at {{site}}, will go back to the PIN.
confirmdeleteaccount: Are you sure you want to remove {{fullname}}'s account on {{sitename}} from this phone? The account stays at the centre: you can sign in again whenever you want.
deletefromcentre: Delete my account at the centre
deletefromcentrehelp: Asks the centre to delete your account and your data. To remove it only from this phone, go to «{{switch}}».
reconnectcode: Did you sign in with a link or a QR code? Ask your organisation for a new one, or get it on its platform, in your user menu: “Open in the Aty app”.
reconnectpassword: Or sign in with your password
removefromphonenote: Removing an account from this phone does not delete it at the centre.
sitecheckfailed: Could not check your organisation: check your connection and try again.
sitenotallowed: This app is for the organisations whose platform Oksigenia hosts, and this one is not among them. Open it in your browser.
switchaccount: This link signs in with the account of {{name}} at {{site}}. Is it your account?
